name: um-tax-scope-reference
description: United States Minor Outlying Islands reference for reviewers selecting the geographic and employer rules relevant to income tax, withholding, social insurance and customs. Trigger on Wake, Midway, Johnston, Palmyra, Baker, Howland, Jarvis, Kingman or Navassa questions. Separates provision-specific United States definitions, possession exclusions and federal contract employment branches. Includes fictional scope controls, required facts, refusal messages and remaining source gates. Each obligation requires its own complete law, facts and qualified review.
